rationale: When use_precision_aware_optimizer=True, get_grads_for_norm must read param.decoupled_grad never param.grad. Needs runtime hook on optimizer to inspect which grad source was selected, gated on config flag (precond). Borderline P7 vs P4: chose P4 because the check is on parameter dtype/source attribute at hook point, not a counter increment. parallel_dim=combo (FSDP+DP).
